reviews.title: Hate the app changes
reviews.text:
First let me say, we love CarMax. They have the absolute best warranty. 

The newest app change stinks. 
Previously, you could change your down payment, credit score, length of loan to get an idea on what you would pay. Now they require you to prequalify and you cannot change the numbers afterwards. This is our go to place for cars but might have to rethink using Carvana since it is more user friendly.

reviews.title: eBay got me more
reviews.text:
Carmax offered me less than $6,000 for my used car. I looked at TrueCar and saw my car going for as much $11,700. I then went to eBay, listed there, and sold it there for $4,000+ over Carmax offer.

Don’t buy into their marketing hype. What you get from Carmax is not a great offer no matter how many times Grandma and her grandson say “that’s a great offer.” The actors are lying. Carmax does not give you a great offer. Want to lose thousands of dollars? Go ahead and sell to Carmax then.

reviews.title: WAY overpriced and their APR’s are horrible!
reviews.text: good selection of cars, but their apr is horrible. even with great credit & a 20% down payment, you will for some reason still get pre-qualified with a 23-29% APR. My first car at 19 with no down payment, no co-signer and no credit was 20%. My credit score is now between 730-740, I do not have bad credit! Not to mention the fact that they overprice the cars to begin with. The prices this company charges just because of name recognition is criminal. You’re so much better off going to a car dealership like Toyota or Honda! If you do decide to buy from them, I recommend getting pre-qualified with a creditable bank first. Please do not scr*w yourself over. That’s all folks!

reviews.title: No Extra Payments to Principal
reviews.text:
Please add an option to make extra principal payments. Other banks/apps have this feature; there’s no excuse. If CarMax thinks this prevents extra principal payments, they’re wrong. However, it wastes plenty of their customers’ time (on purpose). This is a good way to lose current and future customers. CarMax knows word of mouth is the single best form of advertisement. 
CarMax wasn’t my only option, as my credit score is phenomenal. I chose CarMax for ease of use/streamlining the purchase process. They’ve proved that transactions can be remarkably smooth while ensuring an extra payment has as much friction as possible. 
I know the devs are capable; CarMax needs to implement the option.
